scope: absence-of-evidence behavior, department and reporting-line non-substitution, employee-ranking prohibition, raw identifier non-disclosure, source immutability, deprecated API validation, and cross-product compatibility
confirmed_behavior: Department membership and manager reporting lines do not create synthetic collaboration edges.
Influencer and isolation rankings return no employee records at the engine boundary and are blocked with HTTP 409 at the API boundary.
The summary reports collaboration analytics unavailable and names the missing measured relationship evidence.
Unavailable responses disclose no employee identifiers or inferred network claims.
Engine construction copies the supplied frame and network calls do not mutate source data.
Deprecated endpoint limits remain validated but cannot weaken the unavailable-data boundary.
interpretation_boundary: NetworkEngine is intentionally unavailable. Department co-membership and reporting structure are not evidence of collaboration, influence, isolation, information flow or departure impact.
remaining_scientific_limits: Observed, consented and appropriately governed relationship events are required before constructing a collaboration graph.
Edge definitions, time windows, missingness, communication-channel bias and intended-use semantics require independent validation.
No employee influence, isolation, centrality or network-based departure claim is validated or exposed.
Small-cell privacy, access control, retention and worker consultation must be resolved before any future relationship-data feature.
release_gate: The safe launch state is unavailable. Enabling network analytics requires new evidence, governance review, dedicated validation and explicit owner authorization.
